name: ibis Samarinda
short_description: A 162-room budget hotel in central Samarinda, next door to sister property Mercure Samarinda, with a rooftop pool and direct mall access.
ai_summary: ibis Samarinda sits beside its sister property Mercure Samarinda in the East Kalimantan capital's city center, offering 162 standard rooms across King and Twin configurations at a budget price point. The hotel shares facilities including a rooftop pool with Mercure next door, and offers its own Kecapi Restaurant, Coffee & Co coffee shop, and fitness center. Guests consistently highlight friendly staff, smooth check-in, and a varied daily breakfast, with direct access to City Centrum mall cited as a major convenience; some reviews note inconsistent WiFi quality.

faqs.question: Is ibis Samarinda connected to Mercure Samarinda?
faqs.answer: They are two separate but adjacent buildings under the same ownership, opened together in 2020 and sharing some facilities including the outdoor pool area between them. ibis Samarinda is the budget-oriented option of the pair, while Mercure Samarinda next door offers larger rooms and suite categories at a higher price point.

faqs.question: What is included at ibis Samarinda?
faqs.answer: The 162-room hotel includes Kecapi Restaurant, a Coffee & Co coffee shop, a rooftop pool with city views, a fifth-floor fitness center, six meeting rooms, free WiFi, air conditioning, and 24-hour room service, with direct walking access to City Centrum mall next door.
